content.answer: Pichle 30 din mein Karachi mein 4 orders aaye, jin mein kul 520 pieces bike. In ka goods value Rs 468,000 tha, aur aap ka brand payout Rs 397,800 bana. Sab se zyada LOT-NOOR009 bika, 300 pieces. Baqi 220 pieces (520 - 300) doosre lots se thay, lekin lookup un lots ki tafseel nahi deta. Yeh figures pichle 30 din ki hain, calendar month ki nahi.
